observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A television studio stage with a white floor, lit backdrop, and an orchestra visible in the background.
observation.dancers: Three men, all dressed in formal tuxedos.
observation.formation_and_space: A line of three dancers facing forward, moving together across the stage, turning, and traveling in a line.
observation.posture: Upright torso with flexible, loose knees; frequently dipping and bending the knees with weight shifting dynamically.
observation.footwork: Stepping, tapping, kicking, crossing legs, and sliding feet on the beat in sync with the music, accompanied by audible tap sounds.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms swing naturally, hands are held near pockets, or arms open outward; sometimes hands are placed behind the ears or on hips.
observation.hips_and_torso: Loose hips and torso bending, swaying, and dipping in coordination with leg movements.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low knee bends, light jumps, and turns traveling across the stage.
observation.costume_and_props: Black tuxedos with white shirts, black bow ties, and pocket squares; no props.
observation.cannot_infer: Low resolution makes precise weight transfers and rapid footwork details difficult to verify conclusively.

signature_moments.what: Dancers walking forward in a line with rubbery, loose knee bends and inward-pointing toes.
Lifting and clicking heels together while keeping knees bent and loose.
Fast leg kicks and crossing steps with rhythmic tapping.
